instruction: Dirty the bed.
Throw the Statue.
Throw a Pan.
Throw the SoapBar across the room at high velocity.
Break the Statue.
Dirty the Cloth and put it on the CounterTop.
Put the dumbbell on the bed.
Turn off the light switch and dirty the mirror.
Dirty the Cloth and leave it inside the Cabinet.
Dirty the Pan.
Drop a Statue near a Tomato.
Find an Egg and break it by dropping it near an open Book.
Open the Cabinet, place a SoapBar in it, and forcefully close the door.
Turn on the DeskLamp and then throw the BaseballBat near the DeskLamp.
Pick up the Statue and drop it from a height near the FloorLamp.
Throw a TennisRacket near the Mirror.
Pick up the Statue, throw it near the Window to see if it can spot a thief.
Put the tomato in the drawer and slice the tomato to ensure pieces fall inside and leave them there.
Break the vase and then turn on the television.
Pick up the Laptop, drop it from a height near the SideTable.
Turn on a CellPhone and drop it onto the hard Floor.
Pickup a statue and throw it near a mirror.
Dirty the Pillow.
Throw the Pot near the Chair.
Put the Pan on the Bed.
